name: Madrid
tagline: From the 1725 suckling pig to Chueca's viral fusion — two Michelin stars for every TikTok line.

Casa Botín.description: The world's oldest restaurant according to Guinness, open since 1725. The wood-oven roast suckling pig is out of this world.

DiverXO.description: Spain's most disruptive cuisine, from chef Dabiz Muñoz. Fourth-best restaurant in the world according to The World's 50 Best 2025.

Swiss Butter.description: The entrecôte with secret sauce that went viral on TikTok. No reservations, guaranteed line, in Chamberí.

Kuoco 360.description: Creative fusion in Chueca that's crushing it on social media — recommended by gastro-influencer Nieves Felipo.

La Casa del Abuelo.description: Madrid's most iconic garlic shrimp and short beer, served since 1906.
